description: Minecraft Interface Mod for MixelPixel.net Server

mods.name: Muxelpuxel Improved
mods.description: Replaces the scoreboard on mixelpixel.net in the most cases with a beautiful and simple bar on the top of the screen.

releases.notes:
### Required to run this mod:
- Minecraft 1.20.1+
- Fabric Loader 0.14.22+ [download it at git](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-loader/releases)
- Fabric Api 0.89.0+ [download it at modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions?g=1.20.1)
- Cloth Config 11.1.106+ [download it at modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config/versions?l=fabric&g=1.20.1)
- _Optional but recommended (to enter config menu):_ Mod Menu [download it at modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/versions?l=fabric&g=1.20.1)

### Whats new?
- patched for MC 1.20.1
- new Logo for main-menu
- fix: mod functions now only runs, when on mixelpixel
- less debug output
